evidence: Read the full diff file and reviewed it only; I did not open the worktree, run any command or run any test, so no check is reported as passed.

DecodeSweep (engine/review/rolerecords.go): a record stored before T4 has no t4 member and decodes as both lists empty and non-nil. A present t4 (null, a missing or null list, an unknown member, a duplicate key, an empty path) is refused with ErrInvalidStored. Old records still decode, which covers the persisted-format risk. This is from reading the code and the tests added in the diff.
Fired() and Candidates() include the T4 lists. T4 ids come after T3 and the existing id order is unchanged. Candidates() still removes duplicate ids.

Leftovers (engine/review/sweep.go) tests the base name suffix, skips deleted paths, removes duplicates, sorts, and returns an empty slice rather than nil. A directory named x.orig is not matched. Sweep passes candidate.Paths and t1.DeletedOrRenamed to it.
The added tests assert both the stored record and the candidate ids. A repository-wide test also decodes every stored sweep.json file under odd/review-results.
Usage text, README and CHANGELOG changes match the tests that pin them. The changelog states that an older binary refuses a record holding t4.
